svg.title: Build / code — Atlas, macropad, Air65
svg.desc: Portfolio-based illustrations: Atlas with blue 2854 bumper and roller intake; the 3×3 macropad with red switch stems and left-side Pro Micro; the Air65 with blue ducts, three-blade propellers, and FPV camera. Original public repositories: astr-19 and drumbit.

svg.title: Atlas — FRC Team 2854 competition robot
svg.desc: Detailed three-quarter illustration based on the portfolio's competition and construction photographs: a low black wedge chassis, three exposed gray intake rollers, blue rubber shooter wheels, aluminum framing, belt and pulley mechanisms, and the blue 2854 competition bumper.

svg.title: IEEE × Keebs nine-switch macropad
svg.desc: Technical illustration based on the portfolio construction photograph: nine exposed clear mechanical switches with red cross stems form a three by three matrix on a black board. A blue Pro Micro controller with two silver solder rows occupies the left side, above an unpopulated OLED header, reset pads, and the anteater silkscreen.

svg.title: Air65 brushless Tinywhoop
svg.desc: Elevated three-quarter illustration of the portfolio's assembled Air65: four pale blue circular propeller ducts with open lower walls and landing feet, clear three-blade propellers, exposed brushless motors and flight controller, translucent white camera canopy, large black FPV lens, and a rearward-leaning black antenna.
